 Follow Pregnant Ciara Finds a Hilariously Unexpected Way To Use Her Baby Bump
 Rhea Tiwari Thu, November 12, 2026 at 8:54 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: @ciara / Instagram As she anticipates the arrival of her fifth child, Ciara is finding creative ways to navigate daily life with her growing baby bump as a pregnant mother of four kids. The celebrated singer recently delighted her followers by sharing a humorous glimpse into her maternity journey. She embraced the unique perks of pregnancy and also showcased a highly relatable and amusing moment involving a hearty meal and her bump as a table.
 Pregnant Ciara puts her baby bump to unexpected use as a table for her pasta plate
 In a recent social media update, the R&B star proved that expectant mothers often find innovative solutions for everyday tasks. Ciara rested a plate of spaghetti directly on her bare belly while enjoying her meal. The image captures her holding a forkful of pasta, glancing away from the camera with a playful expression.
 She affectionately captioned the post, "If this is what love looks like, keep my plate full". By effectively using her baby bump as a makeshift table, Ciara highlighted the practical, lighter side of her pregnancy.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement This is not the first time this season that the performer has used her changing figure for a clever purpose. On October 31, she incorporated her pregnancy into a stunning Halloween costume. She paid homage to music legend Diana Ross by recreating a vintage 1972 photograph of the singer.
 Since Ross was expecting her daughter Tracee Ellis Ross in the original picture, Ciara utilized her own bump as the ultimate prop to complete the look. She also shared photos from the golden field photoshoot, captioning the tribute, "Two hearts that beat as one. Diana Ross."
 The singer and her husband, Russell Wilson, announced in September 2026 that they are expanding their family once again. This new arrival will soon join the growing roster of kids, marking Ciara's fifth child overall and her fourth with the NFL quarterback. As she progresses through her pregnancy, the 41-year-old continues to share her journey with a perfect blend of fashion tributes and candid moments.
